SELECT uc.* FROM t_user_cosmetic uc INNER JOIN t_cosmetic_def cd ON cd.code = uc.cosmetic_code LEFT JOIN t_user_cosmetic_loadout cl ON cl.user_id = uc.user_id WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND uc.quantity > 0
AND cd.effect_mode = #{effectMode}
AND cd.category = #{category}
AND (uc.expire_at IS NULL OR uc.expire_at > NOW())
AND uc.expire_at IS NOT NULL AND uc.expire_at <= NOW()
AND (cd.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR cd.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND ( (cd.slot = 'AVATAR_FRAME' AND COALESCE(cl.avatar_frame_code, '') = uc.cosmetic_code) OR (cd.slot = 'COMMENT_CARD' AND COALESCE(cl.comment_card_code, '') = uc.cosmetic_code) OR (cd.slot = 'COMMENT_FONT' AND COALESCE(cl.comment_font_code, '') = uc.cosmetic_code) OR (cd.slot = 'POST_CARD' AND COALESCE(cl.post_card_code, '') = uc.cosmetic_code) OR (cd.slot = 'PROFILE_BG' AND COALESCE(cl.profile_bg_code, '') = uc.cosmetic_code) )
AND NOT ( (cd.slot = 'AVATAR_FRAME' AND COALESCE(cl.avatar_frame_code, '') = uc.cosmetic_code) OR (cd.slot = 'COMMENT_CARD' AND COALESCE(cl.comment_card_code, '') = uc.cosmetic_code) OR (cd.slot = 'COMMENT_FONT' AND COALESCE(cl.comment_font_code, '') = uc.cosmetic_code) OR (cd.slot = 'POST_CARD' AND COALESCE(cl.post_card_code, '') = uc.cosmetic_code) OR (cd.slot = 'PROFILE_BG' AND COALESCE(cl.profile_bg_code, '') = uc.cosmetic_code) )
ORDER BY uc.acquired_at DESC, uc.id DESC
